title: Loquitur registered vocabulary
description: One version of the registered vocabulary of one kind: the values a governed member of a public object may take, each with the version that registered it, its status, a title and the profile that defines it. The kinds are closed here; the values are registered data, added or deprecated without a change to any schema (verification-vocabularies.md sections 5 and 6). Two rules no keyword states are part of the document's contract: no value's since is later than the document's version, and asset_types is present on a value exactly when kind is workflow (section 6).

kind.description: The kind of value the document registers. The set of kinds is closed: adding one is a change to the protocol (verification-vocabularies.md section 10).

version.description: The version of this vocabulary, MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with no pre-release label. Adding or deprecating a value is a minor version, correcting a title a patch (verification-vocabularies.md section 9).

values.description: The registered values, by value. A value is never removed, renamed or reinterpreted.

since.description: The version of the vocabulary that registered the value; never later than the document's version, and never changed.

profile.description: The profile that defines the value, or null when no profile document defines it yet.

asset_types.description: For a workflow, the asset types it applies to. Informative in this version: no verifier checks that a workflow and an asset type belong together.
